chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadl from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who divorced his wife three times, and a man wanted to marry her, what should he do? He said: He goes to him and says, 'You divorced so-and-so.' When he says 'Yes,' he leaves her for three months, then proposes to her directly.
ai.seo_question: What is the procedure for a man to marry a woman after her first husband gave her a triple divorce?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the mechanism of 'Iddah' (waiting period) in the context of a triple divorce, emphasizing that the first husband must explicitly confirm the divorce before the three-month period begins. It highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the new husband must propose to the woman directly, ensuring her consent is obtained independently after the waiting period concludes. This procedure underscores the importance of clear verbal declaration and the distinct separation of the divorce act from the subsequent remarriage process.
